# Supported commands

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_docs.py - do not edit by hand -->

**158 dedicated parsers** covering **232 command patterns**. Anything not listed still parses through the generic engine (and through ntc-templates / Genie when installed).

Grammar: `[optional]`, `(a | b)` alternatives, `<param>` single token, `<param...>` rest of line. Abbreviations are accepted everywhere (`sh ip int br`).

| Platform | Parsers | Patterns | Regression fixtures |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Cisco IOS XR (`iosxr`) | 62 | 96 | 87 |
| Juniper Junos OS / Junos OS Evolved (`junos`) | 48 | 60 | 66 |
| Huawei VRP (NE/CX/AR/CE/S series) (`vrp`) | 48 | 76 | 77 |
